title: Plimpy Mod
description: This Minecraft mod is based on my friend PlimpyDimpy and is full of cool surprises!
body:
**About The Mod**

In this mod you can find creatures called plimpies when you go to the plimpy dimension or the plimpy biome!

There are also cool and funny structure/items!

Go to the gallery to see images of the mod!

**Plimpy Mob:**


![This is the Plimpy Mob](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bee901803feb789fb66e38e1ffe6b6e9f8c0dfb9.png)


Note: All the songs are made with Ai!
